description: Abstract class for transform nodes in the Thingsboard rule engine, handling message transformation logic including success and failure handling.

classes.name: TbAbstractTransformNode
classes.description: Abstract class implementing TbNode for message transformation with success and failure handling, parameterized by configuration type C.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with context and configuration, loading specific node configuration.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages asynchronously, invoking transformation logic.

methods.name: loadNodeConfiguration
methods.description: Abstract method to load node-specific configuration.

methods.name: transformFailure
methods.description: Handles transformation failure by notifying context.

methods.name: transformSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful transformation, sending messages or acknowledging as appropriate.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Abstract method to perform message transformation, returning a future list of messages.
